$comment: HAND-AUTHORED from official-BinCodeMap-Example.xml (Rule 10, D-030). SEMI's own BinCodeMap example. Three things make it the corpus's most realistic document: MapType is ABSENT, so the prose default 2DArray applies with no XSD default to lean on; there is no Layouts block at all, so the lattice comes from the payload rather than from a declared Dimension and the LayoutSpecifier "WaferLayout/Devices" dangles; and a ReferenceDevice is present with logical Coordinates and no Position. The round wafer is 12x11 with the corners as NullBin, which is why every row has a different token count of real devices.
